---
name: Bug report / Signaler un bug
about: Report a reproducible problem using fictional data
labels: []
---

**Problem / Problème**: What happened and what did you expect?

**Steps / Étapes**: Minimal commands and fictional fixture to reproduce.

**Environment / Environnement**: VCR version or commit, Python version and OS.

**Limits / Limites**: What was not checked?

Do not include secrets, personal data, private reports or session histories. For vulnerabilities, see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/MaximeFARRE/vibe-coding-reference/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
